description:
PvZ2 Gardendless — A web-based reimagining of Plants vs. Zombies 2.
Each world requires its unique Key item to access. Modern Day unlocks
once a configurable number of world goals are met. Victory = defeat the
Modern Day Zomboss.

v0.1.description:
# Release v0.1
First release of the PVZ2 GE archipelago integration!

## Items
* Plants
* Permanent upgrades

## Locations
* Level Completion
* Shop items with Shopsanity

## Options to reach Main Goal
Set goal based on:
- Reaching world keys
- Reaching the first boss of the world
- Completing worlds

## Main goal Settings
By completing the prerequisite goal chosen above you unlock access to the ***Modern Day***. There you have the option of making the completion goal:
- World Key (Level 16)
- Zomboss  (Level 32)
- Completion (Level 44)

## Other Settings
* Deathlink
* Shopsanity
* Skip tutorial stages
* Having randomized conveyer plants
* Traps (costume shuffle and mower deploy)

## Setup
This produces the actual game — an Electron app with the Archipelago client injected — via a Tk GUI installer, not a CLI build. Launch it either:

From Archipelago: install the .apworld, open the Archipelago Launcher, and click "PvZ2 Gardendless Installer". After the build finishes, launch "PvZ Gardendless AP.exe".
Standalone: python pvz2gardendless/build_pvzge_ap.py
Pick a build directory in the GUI, then it will:

Check that git, node, and npm are on your PATH.
Clone PVZGE-Electron (the Electron wrapper) and pvzge_web (the game source, ~300MB, from master).
Overwrite tmpPatch.js with the Archipelago client code (save-slot redirection, plant-unlock gating, location/item sync, etc.).
Patch main.js to enable F12 devtools.
Run npm install.
Run npm run build:win (or :mac / :linux), producing PvZ Gardendless AP.exe.
This takes several minutes the first time (clone + npm install + packaging).

Requirements: [Python 3.8+](https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-380/), [Node.js 18+](https://nodejs.org/en/download), [Git](https://git-scm.com/install/).

At the top left there is an "AP" button you can click to input the IP address, password and slot information.

## Plans for the future:
This release ***should*** be completely playable. Further testing is required. On that note i'd like to add the option to have random zombies in each level as well as having a zombie spawning trap. I think there's still a bug where after closing and reopening the game you lose your coins and gems.
v0.1.title: Plants vs. Zombies 2 Gardendless Archipelago Release Alpha v0.1

v0.2.0.description:
# Features
- Options are now grouped
- World Whitelist
- Side Paths
- Danger Rooms
- Random Conveyors
- Random Zombies (Still WIP guaranteed to get stuck somewhere)
- Added Traps and trap weight
- Starting plant amount
- Deathlink is now quickly accessible in the AP menu
- AP menu also shows current goal progress

## Commands
Added command "pvz2 resync" type this in a connected text client to receive all coins/gems given through checks in case they are lost

# Bug Fixes and Changes
- Goal conditions have changed to give mcguffins on certain levels. No longer opens modern day and requires you to play through it.
- Modern day access added into the standard pool
- Worlds are now opened by receiving a Progressive World Unlock, each world has 3 that split the world by objective
- Conveyor randomization now feels balanced (should be beatable)
- Almanac is open from the start
- World key levels NO longer give actual world keys (bug let you go to other worlds early)
- Side paths and danger rooms are now optional adders instead of in the base settings
- Changed how shopsanity adds checks, when the base game updates the shop sometimes rotations. Rotation plants have been removed from the list of checks
- Updated shopsanity to show unlockable plants as "In-Logic" when accessible
- Changed the weight of certain plants and upgrades spawning in small seeds
- Misc. Balance/World entry requirements
- Misc. Changes in logic
- Support for Universal Tracker

## Future Plants/WIP
- WIP on logic per world on "required" plants
- Looking into logic for giving appropriate plants for zombie randomization
- Possibly adding in random plants for levels that give you set plants
